description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named HealthCheck, which performs a health check on the Supabase backend by attempting to read data from a 'profiles' table and verifying authentication. It provides UI feedback on connectivity status, hosts, and client configuration, and includes functionality to re-run the health check.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays the health status of the connection to a Supabase database, including connectivity, host information, and client status.

classes.name: _HealthCheckState
classes.description: State class for the HealthCheck widget, contains logic for performing health checks and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: _runCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the Supabase backend by attempting to query the 'profiles' table and retrieving user information as a fallback. Updates the widget state based on the success or failure of these operations.
